officialText:
Section 210.52(J) – Add a new Section 210.52(J) to read as follows:

(J)Outlet Requirements For Residential-Type Occupancies. In addition to the requirements set forth in (A) through (I) of this section, living rooms, bedrooms, dining rooms or similar rooms shall have at least 1 receptacle outlet installed for air conditioners. Such receptacle outlets shall be supplied by an individual branch circuit.

Exception: For buildings with central air conditioning systems, a separate receptacle outlet shall not be required in any living room, bedroom, dining room, or other similar room served by such system.
